author: Komorebi P.

matching_objective.optimality_scope: global over all binary words of the fixed length and requested D4 endpoint under the complete five-coordinate lexicographic ordering; the first three coordinates define scientific exposure matching, while Hamming distance and binary lexical order are deterministic tie-breaks
matching_objective.same_endpoint_constraint: a control must differ when its matching template already has the requested endpoint

identity_pair_alias_structure: At each budget 16, 32, and 64, the frfr reference is the rfrf identity control and the rfrf reference is the frfr identity control. Thus six condition aliases reuse another condition's word and the two directed cells encode one unordered identity-path comparison per budget.

word_length_parity_obstruction.primary_panel: reference plus the four exactly length-matched even-parity endpoints
word_length_parity_obstruction.secondary_panel: the four odd-parity endpoints evaluated at both B-1 and B+1; this is a parity-sandwich sensitivity analysis, not exact length matching
word_length_parity_obstruction.statement: Every D4 defining relation over R,F has even length, so word length parity is invariant. An even budget reaches exactly four of eight endpoints. Same-length controls for all endpoints do not exist.
